feedback: The confession follows the pre-vote inference directly: no bottle projection existed, the physical vessel was reachable, and Elle had already admitted contact with the waiting glass. Taking poison at the preview and using it later specify the act, but these are confirmations of the inferred mechanism rather than decisive new clues. Her fear that repayment would not prevent exposure is a credible continuation of the advance-money dispute. The fabric becoming a permanent reminder gives her artistic attachment an emotional consequence. Hugh and Chip also retain responsibility for their separate failures, which avoids making innocence morally weightless. The confession is somewhat explicit about its evidentiary logic, but feels earned and closes the identified contradiction.
